style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent clinical-minimal skincare visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of pure white #FFFFFF, warm off-white #F2F0ED, silver-grey sweep #C9C7C5 and one champagne fluid accent #E2BE88; neutral high-key studio lighting with one hard directional key from the upper left and crisp defined cast shadows; modern geometric sans-serif with generous letter spacing; thin single-weight circular line icons only; clean high-end skincare packshots mixed with sparse infographic labelling; every claim carried only as an empty placeholder slot; stable upright eye-level product scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no rendered marketing copy.

no rendered marketing copy instead of placeholder slots
